coverage.evidence: ChatActivityTemplateHelpers.cs:35,44 registers the activity namespace over ActivityRingHelpers, ActivityStreamHelpers and ActivityDayHelpers. ActivityRingHelpers.cs:20-31 lets activity.mpm take 0 or 1 argument, and :39-53 and :66-83 make chatters.active and random.recent need exactly 1. ActivityStreamHelpers.cs:37-49 makes top.list need 1 argument (args: 1). BroadcastRow.cs:48-50 returns null when the argument count is wrong, and TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:46 then prints the helper as written.

PeopleText.cs:24 and StreamText.cs:30 format counts with N0 in the channel culture. NumberCulture.cs:24-25 falls back to English. StreamText.cs:153-154 gives 'Name (count)' for top.stream. ActivityStreamHelpers.cs:42-46 joins 'Name count' with ', '. StreamText.cs:68-75 gives 4s, 3m 12s or 1h 5m. ActivityRingHelpers.cs:103-104 rounds mpm away from zero. ActivityDayHelpers.cs:64 prints hour:00 and :67-70 prints the day name in the culture. A null value prints as written (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:46). top.list on an empty list joins to an empty string (ActivityStreamHelpers.cs:42-46).

BroadcastRow.cs:53 gives every activity row TemplateHelperContexts.Standard. TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22 defines Standard as every context except Viewer: Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord and Webhook (TemplateHelperContext.cs:18-50). FeatureService.cs:93 names the Viewer Templates feature.

ActivityRingHelpers.cs:101 sets MaxMinutes = 60. StreamText.cs:157-158 TryPositive accepts a whole number from 1 to max. ChatActivityRing.cs:25 keeps a 60-minute Window in memory, and ChatActivityRecorder.cs records every ChatMessageReceivedEvent.

StreamStatsService.cs:48-49 returns NOT_FOUND before any stream, and :121-123 picks the newest stream by StartedAt (live or last). ChatMetric.cs:33 and TopChattersMetric.cs:33 leave out banned people. StreamFactReader.cs:136 caps the list at 5 and :147-148 orders by count, then by name with ordinal comparison. ActivityStreamHelpers.cs:68 sets MaxListed = 25. CommandExecutedBroadcastHandler.cs:35-41 counts only succeeded commands into a per-registry-context CommandsUsed. ChannelOnlineHandler.cs:153 clears only SessionChatters, so CommandsUsed is not reset on go-live. ChannelRegistry.cs:44,730 evicts an offline context after 2 hours.

ActivityData.cs:50-52 takes today as the date in the channel zone, and :58 and :71-77 query that ActivityDate. ViewerEngagementDailyProjection.cs:66 and ChannelAnalyticsDailyProjection.cs:78 bucket rows by the UTC date of OccurredAt. ActivityData.cs:28,100 looks back 90 days. ChannelAnalyticsService.cs:454,503-504 shifts the hour cells into the channel zone. ActivityDayHelpers.cs:79-85 breaks ties by the lower key (earlier hour; DayOfWeek with Sunday = 0). ChannelAnalyticsService.cs:171 orders top viewers by count only, so the winner of a tie is arbitrary.

ChannelOnlineHandler.cs:153 clears channelCtx.SessionChatters on go-live. ChatMessageHandler.cs:172 adds every chatter on every provider. ActivityStreamHelpers.cs:52-55 counts unique chatters from SessionChatters. ActivityDayHelpers.cs:49-55 computes lurkers as Max(0, Twitch total - SessionChatters.Count).

reader_answers.evidence: The ring helpers read the 60-minute in-memory window (ActivityRingHelpers.cs:20-98, ChatActivityRing.cs:25). The stream helpers read the latest stream's saved chat (ActivityStreamHelpers.cs:22-49, StreamStatsService.cs:121-123). The minutes argument is a whole number from 1 to 60 (ActivityRingHelpers.cs:101, StreamText.cs:157-158).

The activity rows use TemplateHelperContexts.Standard (BroadcastRow.cs:53), which lists every surface except Viewer (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22). That covers command, event response, timer, pipeline, Discord and webhook, and not a viewer's own text.

A null value prints the raw placeholder (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:46). top.list joins an empty list into an empty string (ActivityStreamHelpers.cs:42-46). The periods match the source: the ring (ChatActivityRing.cs:25), the stream window (StreamStatsService.cs:121-123), live context values (ActivityRows.cs:47) and the analytics days (ActivityData.cs:50-58).

random.recent picks uniformly from the distinct authors in the window (ActivityRingHelpers.cs:73-80) and does not leave out the person who set off the reply. It prints as typed when nobody chatted (authors.Count == 0 gives null, :80). last.chatter skips the trigger's user.id (ActivityRingHelpers.cs:90-95).
